KeyM@n + XPress 6.group: KeyM@n layer (firmware): side key becomes a plain F-key on the keyboard collection
KeyM@n + XPress 6.description: keyman + right, top one of five, f6

notes: All extra keys are on the consumer-control collection (interface 1, report ID 1, 3-byte report 01 lo hi); release is 01 00 00.
KeyM@n is a firmware layer: holding it makes the ten side keys send plain F1-F10 on the keyboard collection. The KeyM@n key alone was not seen (expected: invisible to user mode).
XPress 1-5 = left column top to bottom, XPress 6-10 = right column top to bottom. Power key was deliberately not pressed.
